dominant_strengths: Restrained dark palette with well-calibrated syntax accents (orange, teal, lavender) keeps focus on code without garish saturation
Completions popover hierarchy is clear: type icon, identifier, return type aligned right with disciplined spacing
Sidebar file-status dots and breadcrumb echo the same hue system, giving quiet cross-component coherence
dominant_weaknesses: Completions popover overlaps and obscures lines 9–14, hiding signal the developer needs while reading the very signature being completed
Status bar's saturated blue band clashes with the otherwise muted neutral chrome and pulls the eye away from the editor
Tab row, breadcrumb, and sidebar headers compete at similar weights, so visual hierarchy between navigation layers feels flat
fix_priorities: Reposition or shrink the completions popover so it floats below the caret without occluding adjacent code
Desaturate the status bar to a near-black tinted band, reserving blue only for the branch glyph
Differentiate tab/breadcrumb/sidebar typography weights to establish a clearer navigational hierarchy
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral polish leads, behavioral utility is decent but compromised by occlusion, and reflective distinctiveness is modest—it reads as a competent IDE rather than a memorable one.
rationale.intent_fit: It delivers a credible 'improved' code editor with refined chrome, but the improvements are incremental cosmetic tuning rather than a structural rethink.
